description: We are a team with a strong background in software development, web technologies, and systems security. Together, our experience spans building responsive web applications, designing efficient data architectures, and integrating hardware with assistive accessibility devices. We are driven by a shared passion for creating technology that solves real-world challenges through clean architecture, security-first engineering, and truly inclusive, accessible design ;)
summary: We developed a web application that converts Earth visualization into sound with the purpose of bringing accessibility to people with visual impairments by complying with WCAG accessibility standards. It has a great importance regarding the way access is managed for all the people, be it with or without any kind of disability, and it could get everyone to begin a journey on Astronomy.
